name: Runner Extras - GUID <> filter with Count()
brief: Pins that SetFilter(GuidField, '<>%1', EmptyGuid) narrows Count() and FindSet the same way it narrows any other field.
description: Resolving a name to exactly one row is a common AL shape: range the identifying fields, exclude rows whose owning-app GUID is empty, then branch on Count() — 0 means unknown, 1 means resolved, more than 1 means ambiguous. If the runner drops the GUID inequality filter, Count() comes back too high and the caller reports AMBIGUOUS for a name that is registered exactly once. That surfaces as a wrong-but-plausible domain error far from the filter, so this pins the filter itself.
